title: Reclaimed Building Components Staffage Collection
description: Use a massive wave of fable agents to create staffage for a huge collection of used building components. Forty handcrafted reclaimed components (timber, steel, concrete, masonry, roof, openings, facade, services) in the staffage archive `🎓️teaching/🏛️architecture/🧍️staffage`, each with rig, poses, clips, thermal and structural model, 2D representations and 3D volumes at 1:50, 1:100, 1:200, 1:500, manifest rows and a collection, verified by the product's validators and tests.
